result.instructions: Tools for TimeTac, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is clocked in right now, and on which task?"; "Show the hours Anna booked last week, grouped by project."; "Which absence requests are still open, and who must approve them?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TimeTac data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timetac_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timetac_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timetac_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. timetac_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timetac_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees (users) of the TimeTac account: id, name, department, active flag, entry/exit dates. Only work-related fields are returned (no credentials, payroll, address or birth data). TimeTac API: GET users/read.

department_id.description: Only users of this department id.

since.description: Only rows modified since this date-time, for example 2026-10-01 00:00:00. Dates older than 3 months return everything.

tools.name: timetac_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one employee by user id. Only work-related fields are returned (no credentials, payroll, address or birth data). TimeTac API: GET users/read?id=.

tools.name: timetac_list_time_trackings
tools.title: List time trackings
tools.description: List time entries (start, end, duration, task, notes, approval), newest first. Filter by user, task or approval. start_date/end_date filter the returned page only; page with offset. TimeTac API: GET timeTrackings/read.

user_id.description: Only entries of this user id.

task_id.description: Only entries booked on this task id.

approved_by_admin.description: Only approved (true) or not approved (false) entries.

start_date.description: Keep entries that start on or after this date.

end_date.description: Keep entries that start on or before this date.

since.description: Only rows modified since this date-time, for example 2026-10-01 00:00:00. Dates older than 3 months return everything.

tools.name: timetac_current_time_trackings
tools.title: Running timers
tools.description: List the timers that run right now (who is clocked in, on which task). TimeTac API: GET timeTrackings/current.

user_id.description: Only the running timer of this user id.

tools.name: timetac_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List absence and leave requests (holiday, sick leave and others) with dates, duration and approval status. from_date/to_date keep requests that overlap the range, on the returned page only. TimeTac API: GET absences/read.

user_id.description: Only requests of this user id.

type_id.description: Only this absence category: 1 = holiday, 2 = overtime reduction, 3 = other paid leave.

subtype_id.description: Only this leave type inside the category (see timetac_list_absence_types).

status.description: Only this status code (0 = open; see the TimeTac docs for the others).

from_date.description: Keep requests that end on or after this date.

to_date.description: Keep requests that start on or before this date.

since.description: Only rows modified since this date-time, for example 2026-10-01 00:00:00. Dates older than 3 months return everything.

tools.name: timetac_list_absence_types
tools.title: List absence types
tools.description: List the absence types of the account (holiday, sick leave, special leave) with their ids. TimeTac API: GET absenceTypes/read.

tools.name: timetac_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects (task tree nodes that group tasks) with ids, deadlines and status. TimeTac API: GET projects/read.

since.description: Only rows modified since this date-time, for example 2026-10-01 00:00:00. Dates older than 3 months return everything.

tools.name: timetac_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks that time can be booked on, with their project (mother_id) and status. TimeTac API: GET tasks/read.

mother_id.description: Only tasks of this project id.

since.description: Only rows modified since this date-time, for example 2026-10-01 00:00:00. Dates older than 3 months return everything.

tools.name: timetac_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List departments with ids and parent departments. TimeTac API: GET departments/read.

tools.name: timetac_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams with ids and names. TimeTac API: GET teams/read.

tools.name: timetac_start_time_tracking
tools.title: Start timer
tools.description: WRITE: start a timer for a user, now or at a given time. Each call can create a new running entry, so do not repeat it. TimeTac API: POST timeTrackings/start.

user_id.description: The user the timer belongs to.

task_id.description: The task to book the time on.

start_time.description: Start date-time. Leave empty to start now.

start_time_timezone.description: IANA time zone of start_time. Needed when start_time is set.

tools.name: timetac_stop_time_tracking
tools.title: Stop timer
tools.description: WRITE: stop the running timer of a user, now or at a given time. TimeTac API: PUT timeTrackings/stop.

user_id.description: The user whose running timer stops.

end_time_timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Vienna.

end_time.description: End date-time. Leave empty to stop now.

tools.name: timetac_create_time_tracking
tools.title: Add time entry
tools.description: WRITE: add a finished time entry for a user. Each call creates a new entry, so do not repeat it. TimeTac API: POST timeTrackings/create.

task_id.description: The task to book the time on.

start_time_timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Vienna.

end_time_timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Vienna.

tools.name: timetac_create_absence
tools.title: Request absence
tools.description: WRITE: create an absence or leave request for a user. Each call creates a new request, so do not repeat it. type_id is the category (1 holiday, 2 overtime reduction, 3 other paid leave); subtype_id picks the leave type from timetac_list_absence_types. TimeTac API: POST absences/create.

type_id.description: Absence category: 1 = holiday, 2 = overtime reduction, 3 = other paid leave.

subtype_id.description: Specific leave type inside the category (for example which other paid leave). See timetac_list_absence_types.

duration.description: Requested duration, in the unit of duration_unit.

tools.name: timetac_approve_absence
tools.title: Approve absence
tools.description: WRITE: approve an open absence request. The employee is notified by TimeTac. TimeTac API: PUT absences/approve.

comment.description: Optional comment shown to the employee.

tools.name: timetac_reject_absence
tools.title: Reject absence
tools.description: WRITE: reject an open absence request. The employee is notified by TimeTac. TimeTac API: PUT absences/reject.

comment.description: Optional comment shown to the employee.

prompts.description: What you can do with TimeTac here, with example requests to try.
